notes: 25 candidates: 4 program-list, 0 single-record, 21 not-a-list. The four program-list pages are WRAP (Warwick Research Archive Portal) thesis browse pages, two near-duplicate views each (by author vs. by item type) of Warwick Business School (330 items, 2014 capture) and its predecessor the School of Industrial and Business Studies (50 PhD theses 1977-1999); both saved texts of the WBS views are cut off before the end of the list, so the live WRAP page should be re-fetched for the full set. They list dissertations with authors and years only, no placements, and cover every business-school area, so operations graduates must be selected by title. The Warwick School of Engineering WRAP lists (358 PhD/EngD theses) were marked not-a-list as general engineering, but they contain a handful of WMG (Warwick Manufacturing Group) EngD/PhD titles on supply chains and manufacturing strategy that an integrator could revisit if WMG is treated as in scope. The USC Marshall Management and Organization placements page (1988-2011) gives initial placement employers by year without names, so it was marked not-a-list; it may still be useful as corroboration for named MOR graduates found elsewhere. No institution-by-host corrections were needed.
